# louppe

> a free, open-source, keyboard-first photo and video culler for macOS

- [website](https://louppe.eu/): product overview, features, and download
- [download](https://github.com/alexander-markin-meow/louppe/releases): macOS releases
- [source code](https://github.com/alexander-markin-meow/louppe): application source
- [author](https://alex-markin.com/): alex markin
